svg.text: SCALE 16:1 · CORE F = 13 · INK IS SCHEMATIC
ONE UNICODE FRAME, REPLACED IN PLACE. NO WIDTH RESERVATION IN THE ROOT.
DASHED BOX = LAYOUT BOX; GLYPH INK AND BASELINE DEPEND ON FONT FALLBACK.
X1 SHIFTS THE WHOLE CELL RIGHT; IT DOES NOT RECENTER EACH FRAME.
PROPORTIONAL INK SCHEMATIC · FIXED ORDER · N FRAMES
SCHEMATIC · ONE DOM SPAN · NO PHYSICAL LAYERS
ONE FIXED BRAILLE SEQUENCE; NO SHAPE VARIANTS.
FONT SIZE IS INHERITED; FONT-MONO IS THE DEFAULT.
WIDTH HUGS THE CURRENT FRAME STRING.
ALL TEN FRAMES SHARE THE MEASURED ADVANCE.
CORE LINE HEIGHT IS ONE EM; NO FIXED SIZE.
THE DEMO TEXT-SM CLASS OVERRIDES LINE HEIGHT.
LOADING FALSE REMOVES THE SPAN AND TIMER.
THE ROOT RESERVES NO SPACE WHILE HIDDEN.
LABEL PRESENT: NAMED STATUS; OTHERWISE HIDDEN.
NATIVE ARIA PROPS MAY OVERRIDE THESE DEFAULTS.
LOADER SLOT CAN RESERVE AN ICON-SIZED BOX.
IT BELONGS TO THE CALLER / SHARED WRAPPER.
NORMALIZED CYCLE AXIS · REDUCED LOOP TAKES M TIMES LONGER
MEASURED CORE CLASSES · NOT BUILT-IN SIZE VARIANTS
WIDTHS ARE BROWSER OBSERVATIONS, NOT PORTABLE FONT METRICS.
SHAPE, ADVANCE AND BASELINE ARE FONT-DEPENDENT.
SHARED WRAPPER CENTERS ITS CHILD IN Z1
SHARED LOADER UTILITY · GLOBAL TYPE TOKENS
